requirements.text: **What You'll Bring*** Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field with a gradation date between 2027\- 2028

This position is expected to start around January/February 2027 and continue through the entire Spring term (ending approximately May 2027 or later, if available). We ask for a minimum of 12 weeks, Full \- Time (40 hours/week) and on\-site, for most internships. Our internship program is for students who are actively enrolled in an academic program. Recent graduates seeking employment after graduation and not returning to school should apply for full\-time positions, not internships.
* Ability to relocate to Palo Alto, CA for the entirety of the internship position
* Proficiency in Java , Python or Scala
* Strong programming fundamentals, particularly in data structures, concurrency, and Java
* Understanding of a complex distributed system, such as Kafka, Spark, Trino or ElasticSearch is a plus
* Previous experience building and optimizing highly available, scalable, distributed back\-end services also a plus
